owner_exception_reason: Owner request (1 November 2026): every Black Market item must also be a real Alchemy element; batch size exception granted by the owner.

new_items.name: Party Hat
new_items.summary: A pointy paper-and-fabric party hat with stripes and a pompom, perfect for a companion who loves to dance at celebrations.

new_items.name: Sports Cap
new_items.summary: A soft fabric cap with a stiff brim that shades the eyes from the sun during races and long days outside.

new_items.name: Top Hat
new_items.summary: A tall black top hat with a red band, the classic hat of stage magicians and very polite companions.

new_items.name: Wizard Hat
new_items.summary: A floppy starry wizard hat with a wide brim, sewn for companions who like to pretend they know a few spells.

new_items.name: Sunglasses
new_items.summary: A pair of dark sunglasses with tinted lenses that keep the bright sun out of a companion's eyes in style.

new_items.name: Star Glasses
new_items.summary: Silly star-shaped party glasses with golden frames, worn by companions who want to look like a celebrity.

new_items.name: Monocle
new_items.summary: A single round lens in a golden rim with a thin chain, worn over one eye by very distinguished companions.

new_items.name: Scarf
new_items.summary: A long warm knitted scarf with yellow stripes, wrapped around a companion's neck on snowy winter days.

new_items.name: Bandana
new_items.summary: A triangular cotton bandana with little white dots, tied around the neck like a pirate or a cowboy on an adventure.

new_items.name: Bow Tie
new_items.summary: A neat red bow tie for concerts and fancy dinners, tied in a perfect knot under a companion's chin.

new_items.name: Hero Cape
new_items.summary: A flowing red hero cape with a golden clasp that flutters behind a companion whenever it runs to the rescue.

new_items.name: Swift Fruit
new_items.summary: A light green fruit that grows on windy hilltops; companions who eat it run noticeably faster for a while.

new_items.name: Sea Fruit
new_items.summary: A round blue fruit found on rocky shores; companions who eat it become stronger and braver swimmers.

new_items.name: Cloud Fruit
new_items.summary: A soft peach-coloured fruit as light as a cloud; companions who eat it glide further through the air.

new_items.name: Strong Fruit
new_items.summary: A heavy red fruit that grows on mountain slopes; companions who eat it hit harder and climb rock walls with ease.

new_items.name: Hearty Fruit
new_items.summary: A bright orange fruit full of juice that keeps a companion going for longer races and tougher fights.

new_items.name: Life Fruit
new_items.summary: A sweet pink fruit with a heart-shaped pit that helps companions recover their health after a hard day.

new_items.name: Hand Mirror
new_items.summary: A small round hand mirror with a golden frame; a companion who looks into it remembers what it really looks like.

new_items.name: Rebirth Egg
new_items.summary: A warm golden egg with a flame pattern, said to come from a phoenix; it brings a companion back to its natural look.

new_items.name: House Garden
new_items.summary: A fenced garden with a lawn and flower beds that extends a companion house outdoors and makes everyone happier.

new_items.name: Outdoor Pool
new_items.summary: A sunny outdoor swimming pool with a little ladder, added to a companion house so residents can practise swimming.

new_items.name: Second Floor
new_items.summary: A whole new upper floor with stairs and a balcony that gives a companion house more room and more residents.

new_items.name: Castle with Garden and Pool
new_items.summary: The grandest companion home of all: a castle with towers, a flowering garden and its own outdoor pool for up to ten companions.
